mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(p.skill_key, '-', v.version) AS skill_id, p.name AS skill_name, p.description AS description FROM skill_release r JOIN skill_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN skill_package p ON p.id = v.package_id JOIN ( SELECT p2.skill_key, MAX(r2.id) AS release_id FROM skill_release r2 JOIN skill_version v2 ON v2.id = r2.version_id JOIN skill_package p2 ON p2.id = v2.package_id WHERE r2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r2.ended_at IS NULL OR r2.ended_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY p2.skill_key ) latest ON latest.release_id = r.id WHERE r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.ended_at IS NULL OR r.ended_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY r.released_at DESC, r.id DESC
